bundle.shortDescription: Cropmark 独立系统截图工具
bundle.longDescription: Cropmark is an independent desktop screenshot tool. Capture a region, window, or screen, annotate, copy or save PNG, and recognize printed Chinese and English offline. Installer, About, and tray use the Cropmark name and icon only.
